## Problem and change

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Link relevant issues or paper sections.

## Validation

List commands run and their results, or explain why checks were not run. For cryptographic changes, describe adversarial cases and affected security assumptions.

## Remaining limitations

Describe known gaps or follow-up work.

- [ ] Changed Go files are formatted with gofmt.
- [ ] Relevant tests and go vet have been run, or exceptions are explained above.
- [ ] Documentation distinguishes implemented behaviour from proposed guarantees.
- [ ] Contributions contain no real credentials, private keys or personal data.
